biocontainers.name: scaden
biocontainers.summary: Cell type deconvolution using single cell data

bioschemas.name: Scaden
bioschemas.summary: Scaden is a deep-learning based algorithm for cell type deconvolution of bulk RNA-seq samples. It was developed at the DZNE Tübingen and the ZMNH in Hamburg. The method is published in Science Advances: Deep-learning based cell composition analysis from tissue expression profiles.
